metadata_policy: Public fixed revision official HF API only; unauthenticated explicit HTTP(S) proxy, trust_env=False, no mirror or credential lookup
non_lfs_missing_sha256_policy: Official immutable Git blob SHA1 verifies full raw bytes including Git blob header. Current SHA256 is separately retained; never invent a preselected SHA256 from those current bytes.

public_metadata_requests.proxy_policy: Explicit unauthenticated HTTP(S) proxy; no SOCKS inheritance

scope: Current complete bytes of all45 prepared files in all5 fixed snapshots; single-thread sequential 8MiB reads, deduplicated realpath/device+inode, no experiment launched
